born: Born. Asks for paint at once
life_event: Sells one painting, to a relative
One painting takes a whole year
life_punchline: A painting found behind a radiator
fact: {artist} painted only {seed.generic}, and only on Tuesdays.
{artist} spent eleven years on one painting of {seed.generic}.
{artist} signed every painting with a tiny drawing of {seed.one}.
{artist} never saw {seed.one} in real life, and it shows.
{artist} was banned from three museums, including this one.
{artist} painted with a brush made of {seed.generic}.
{artist} invented the colour beige, and then regretted it.
Experts agree that {artist} could not draw hands, so every hand is hidden behind {seed.one}.
fact_source: A guard who has worked here forever
post_title: The artist, in their own words
post: Painted {seed.generic} again today. My patron wants something else. My patron does not understand art.
Day 412 of painting {seed.generic}. Still not right. Starting again tomorrow.
Finished my masterpiece. It is {seed.one}. Nobody will understand it for three hundred years.
Sold a painting today! To my mother. She asked for a refund.
The critics say there's too much {seed.bare} in my paintings. The critics are wrong.
Tried to paint a bowl of fruit. It turned into {seed.generic} again. Third time this week.
My apprentice says I'm obsessed with {seed.generic}. My apprentice is now painting the fence.
